RULES & REGULATIONS
1.
The quiz will be based on the theme "INDIA
2.
The registration fee is 100 per team.
3.
Each team shall consist of exactly two (2) members.
There is no limit on the number of teams that can participate from a
single institution. An institution may register any number of teams.
5.
Only students studying in Classes 8 to 12 are eligible to participate.
6.
Students may participate representing their School/Educational
Institution, MGOCSM Unit, or Parish.
7.
The Quiz Competition will commence sharp at 9:45 a.m. All participants
are requested to be present and ready before the scheduled time.
8.
The competition will consist of two rounds:
Round 1 - Preliminary Round (Written)
Round 2 – Final Round
9.
The Preliminary Round will be a written round, and the top five teams
based on their scores will qualify for the Final Round.
10.
Mobile phones, smart watches, calculators, earphones, and all other
electronic or smart devices are strictly prohibited during the Preliminary Round.
11.
A sealed attestation/certificate from the Head of the Institution confirming
the eligibility of the participants must be submitted along
with the registration.
12.
The decision of the Quiz Master will be final and binding.
13.
The registration fee is non-refundable.
